title: Tuna Fishcakes
description: Pantry fishcakes that come together in under half an hour — panko and parmesan for structure, lemon and smoked paprika for lift. Makes 6 cakes.
notes: Form larger patties instead of six small ones and serve them on buns as fish burgers.

ingredients.name: tuna
ingredients.note: 3 oz pouch or 5 oz can, drained

steps.text: In a small skillet, heat the butter over medium heat. Cook the yellow onion and garlic until translucent and fragrant.
Add every remaining ingredient except the frying oil to a large bowl, including the cooked onion and garlic. Mix well.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop up the mixture and form it into patties about 1/2-inch thick.
steps.tip: Press firmly — loosely packed cakes fall apart in the pan.

steps.text: Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over medium heat and cook the fishcakes until golden, 1-2 minutes per side. Sprinkle with salt and serve hot with your favourite dipping sauce.
